params.1273: There's a small pile of coins on the ground near Explorer Jack's house. Click on it to pick it up.
params.1274: You can walk around by clicking on the ground where you wish to go.
params.1275: Walk to the spot where the coins are lying (click on the ? to the right of this hint for a waypoint arrow).
params.1276: If you cannot see the arrow, check on the minimap in the top right of the screen to see which direction to go.
params.1277: Click on the coins to take them.
params.1278: You can left-click to carry out the default option for a person or thing, or right-click for an expanded menu.
